robot.note: Read-only observations, not permission to move. Stale/missing fields are unknown. Guard reason is inferred, not a guard acknowledgement. No navigation status message means unknown, not proof of idle. Map known area is not room coverage.

decision_context.authority: Only local task state establishes success, cancellation or stopped.

choice.rationale_summary: 预算充足且未锁停，继续探索。两个安全候选均在当前分区；选择3，以约多4.4秒的总成本换取更多首个未知边界采样增量（105对90）、更低遮挡及更大已知障碍净空，并向较远边界推进。收益仅为代理，不计墙后未知为可见收益；不重发被拒目标，执行前须复核当前地图安全。
